mods.name: AFK Bot Mod
mods.description: Spawns a fake player bot that stands in the server to keep chunks loaded.

releases.notes:
Updates the AFK Bot Mod to **Minecraft 26.2**.

### Requirements
- Minecraft **26.2**
- Fabric Loader **0.19.3+**
- Fabric API **0.152.2+26.2**
- Java **25+**

### Changes
- Bumped toolchain/deps to 26.2 (Loom 1.17, Gradle 9.5.1)
- No gameplay changes — straight port from 26.1; all commands and limits unchanged

### Install
Drop `afk-bot-mod-1.2.1.jar` into your server's `mods/` folder (server-side only, no client install needed).

readmeSummary: A simple, standalone server-side Fabric mod that spawns fake player bots to keep chunks loaded and farms running. No Carpet mod or client-side install required — just drop it in and go.
